title: Holiday 2026: What's shaping shoppers' plans
summary: Making smart, well-informed decisions is the key to financial freedom. We hope these great tips will enhance your shopping experiences.

October 15, 2026


# Holiday 2026: What's shaping shoppers' plans


[Learn more about working with Bread Financial](https://www.breadfinancial.com/en/business-solutions.html)


Prices at the pump are influencing how and where shoppers will spend


Holiday spending plans remain modest, but steady from last year: **54%**


plan to spend the same, **27%**


more and **19%**


less. But shopping behaviors may shift as shoppers grapple with this year's grinch — gas prices. Read on for the details — and for how AI may influence shoppers — from Bread Financial’s first consumer survey of the holiday 2026 shopping season.


Gas price impact


Most ( **79%**


) report that gas prices are impacting holiday shopping plans this year (highest among Gen Z, at **89%**


). As a result, shoppers are making fewer trips and reconsidering where they might shop this year.


**How gas prices are impacting holiday plans**
*Among holiday shoppers*


Image


AI's helping hand


Watching for sales is still a top way shoppers plan to rein in spending, but this year, **71%**


are open to an AI-powered assist when deal-hunting and for other activities. Gen Z and millennials (at **81%**


each) are most likely to use AI this year.


**Top ways holiday shoppers plan to leverage AI**
*Among holiday shoppers*


Image


Financing influencing spend


While shoppers are most likely to use debit cards or cash for purchases to keep spending in check, half ( **51%**


) indicate that a credit-card offer, like a cardholder discount, could sway payment choice—and drive additional spend.


**Credit card offers (net) could entice additional holiday spend**
*Holiday shoppers by generation*


Image


Key takeaway: Gas prices may steer the sleigh this season


With **79%**


of shoppers adjusting plans due to gas prices, **71%**


open to AI-powered assists and **51%**


who might let a credit-card offer sway payment choice, value and convenience may well decide where dollars land. Marketers may want to make pickup and delivery options easy to compare, help promotions surface in AI-assisted search and lead with cardholder discounts that could capture consolidated trips.


*Source: Bread Financial Holiday Look Ahead survey, Sept-26*
